headline: 侠探杰克双榜霸屏，本周新片冷启动
headlineEn: Reacher dominates both charts, quiet week for new movies
summary: 电影《最后的曙光》《怒之杀》领跑今日热度，剧集《黑色丽人》《绿灯军团》表现强势；《侠探杰克》电影剧集双版本齐上榜。本周8部新片待映，今日零上映。
summaryEn: Movies 'The Last Dawn' and 'Wrath of Kill' lead today's heat, while TV series 'Dark Beauty' and 'Green Lantern Corps' surge; 'Reacher' appears on both film and TV charts. 8 new movies this week, zero today.
